newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu, Volvo to end Japan truck sales tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu, Volvo to end Japan truck sales tie-up.

text.p: Isuzu Motors Ltd said on Friday that it and the AB Volvo group have agreed to end their tie-up in marketing large Volvo trucks in Japan.

Isuzu and Volvo agreed on the marketing deal in 1989. Isuzu started selling Volvo's 16,000 cc FH16 truck in 1990. But the Japanese automaker had only been able to sell about 200 Volvo trucks since then.
The Swedish company plans to consolidate its truck sales channels in Japan under its Japanese subsidiary Volvo Cars Japan Corp.
An Isuzu spokesman said the Volvo truck had been complementing Isuzu's own truck lineup, but Isuzu plans to introduce its own large truck shortly.
